wholePhysicalScope: Native hospital multipolygon 15256286, including its exterior and six inner rings. The Thomas Street way and adjacent footway inform the public-facing axis.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain the six open courtyards, low ward roofs and front and rear hospital canopies. Near levels add glazing, lining and roof details.
limitations: Ward eaves, roof pitches, levels, courtyard treatment, windows, materials palette and entrance canopies are estimated from the mapped shape and documented materials. The six courtyard rings and the street alignment come from the native map.
Awning locations are inferred within the mapped Thomas Street projection and the rear car-park side. Site structures outside the current main building outline are outside this model’s scope.
The original elevation field remains unchanged. Foundation steps and local thresholds are approximated from the coarse grade at the physical wing and entrance positions.
